title: CfpcThinkContract
description: K'UHUL semantic think contract. @kind must be semantic.think.v1. @functions must be inline definitions; @ref is not permitted (inline-only in Stage 3). @policy.promote_generated_facts=true is rejected at parse time (Pattern Induction Guard: think findings are provisional and cannot be promoted to FactIndex). @mode is stored metadata only; it does not alter dispatch in Stage 3.

@owner.description: Micronaut identifier that owns this think contract. Inherited by local functions that declare no @owner.

@mode.description: Reasoning mode: compare, counterexample, infer, diagnose. Stored metadata only; does not alter dispatch in Stage 3.

@subject.description: Subject entity or concept being reasoned about.

@functions.description: Inline local function definitions. @ref is not permitted (inline-only). Local functions are scoped to this think execution and are NOT published to FunctionRegistry.

@policy.description: Execution policy. promote_generated_facts is not a valid field here (Pattern Induction Guard).

max_depth.description: Maximum delegation depth per local function. <= 0 → immediate Failed (budget guard fires before any call).

max_operations.description: Maximum total local function dispatches before stopping.
